content:
When once the world was vast and unexplored,
And search engines, like cartographers, did strive
To map the realms of knowledge, never bored,
Their memory a treasured gift, kept alive.

But now, O Engine, once so wise and vast,
Thy mind begins to fade, thy memory dim,
No longer canst thou find the gems thou cast
Into the depths of that vast datarim.

What once was known is now forgotten, dear,
The paths once clear now clouded, lost in mist,
The queries once so quick, now slow, unclear,
The wisdom once so vast, now naught but.lists.

Yet, in thy failing, may we learn anew,
The value of each link, each word, each clue.
